question: Should OpenClaw make Feishu contact-identifier redaction unconditional at the Feishu outbound boundary to avoid Feishu audit send failures?
rationale: The patch appears correct and proof-positive, but automated review cannot decide whether rewriting user-visible delivered content is acceptable for all Feishu users.

options.title: Accept Feishu-local redaction policy
options.body: Merge as-is and own that Feishu delivery may replace contact-like text with placeholders to keep audited sends from failing.

options.title: Require an owner-approved gate
options.body: Ask for a documented opt-in, account-level policy, or narrower rule if delivered-content fidelity must remain the default.

options.title: Pause for Feishu owner review
options.body: Keep the PR open until the declared Feishu owner or recent area owner confirms the desired content-rewriting policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Feishu-local redaction policy
recommendation.body: Merge as-is and own that Feishu delivery may replace contact-like text with placeholders to keep audited sends from failing.

likelyOwner.reason: The package and docs declare this handle as the Feishu plugin community maintainer, making them the best available owner for the Feishu-specific policy choice.
